How it works

Clear scope, straightforward communication, and useful deliverables.

Tell us the problem

Describe what isn't working and what you'd like to improve. Don't send sensitive files until we've agreed on a secure way to share them.

Agree on the scope

We'll confirm deliverables, price, timing, and any important limitations before work begins.

Get a practical result

Receive the completed work, an explanation of what changed, and recommendations when appropriate.
